userStories.title: Metra feed script and tests
userStories.description: Stdlib-only bin/metra_train.py decoding GTFS-RT tripupdates for two configured trains/stop (secrets metra_trains/metra_stop); pytest suite with real fixture.
acceptanceCriteria: Stdlib imports only
Token + config from /config/secrets.yaml (or METRA_SECRETS), 8s fetch timeout
Wire decoder with pinned field numbers; unknown fields skipped
Match _<fragment>_; arrival.time fallback departure.time
Scheduled times from metra_trains config, ZoneInfo America/Chicago
delay=floor(sec/60+0.5); rounding edge tests
Output keys delay,status,scheduled_departure,expected_departure,last_update,error; statuses on_time/delayed/cancelled/no_data with error codes
Outside 06:45-09:00 -> no_data/outside_window with no network call; injectable clock
Always exit 0 + valid JSON; token/URL never printed
Fixture decodes 52 entities; MN2152 fixture trip @ its downstream stop -> -2
Tests: not_in_feed, CANCELED, SKIPPED, outside window, missing config, missing token, 401, timeout, garbage, token absent, DST
Dev-only cross-check vs gtfs-realtime-bindings recorded in working-memory
pytest tests/test_metra_train.py passes

userStories.title: Delay alert automation
userStories.description: cristina_train_delay_alert: push/re-push/clear per train with helper dedup.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggers: sensor state + attribute status per train, ids 1/2; none on last_update
mode queued
Conditions: office day on, then null-safe not-yet-departed template
No home/zone condition
no_data/unknown/unavailable = no-op; cancelled push once (h=999); delay>=5 push when h=-1 or |delay-h|>=5; on_time numeric<5 with h!=-1 clears + h=-1
general_notification devices cfalb, time-sensitive, tag metra-<slot>
Helper written only in those branches, never from trigger.from_state
Aliases on templates/branches; short header
